ops.title: lr-main-red handoff: cc-skills#3756 turns main's lr-go green
ops.body:
Lane lr-main-red (meta-desk-3), brief /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/meta-desk-3/b/lr-main-red.md.

Deliverable: one yasyf/cc-skills PR turning main's lr-go green. PR #3756 https://github.com/yasyf/cc-skills/pull/3756, branch lr-main-red, head 6533a457fa92cd774be15ca47d4f917fab99cba5, worktree /Users/yasyf/repos/claude/worktrees/cc-skills/lr-main-red. Its long-running CI run is 42328580908.

What the PR does:
- A: #3749 (4ef5a213d) already deleted the failing harness test and moved the body read into portState. Traced the product: the supervisor runs Snapshot then WriteRows; WriteRows posts the pr.read record with body and its Pass folds it (ApplyBody sets Description) before the port step. The product was right. Added TestAPortWhoseHeadRecordOmitsItsSourceTakesItFromItsBodyOnTheSupervisorsPass (Snapshot then WriteRows).
- B: five tests rewritten to the once-per-PR tap ruling (60f978d): stack replay (changed patch carries the tap, a delta=fundamental one does not, the go stays same-patch only), Retro row 47 (fixture is now fundamental, still goes back to him), Retro row 98 (three changed heads land by=tap), Grades (ungraded at the new head, tap still counts), Minute his post reached him (carries to a changed head, restarts only on fundamental).
- C: copied skills/long-running/reference/fidelity-desk-brief.md over lr/internal/grading/grader/briefs/.
- D: orca/worker_test.go fake git prints $FETCH_TOKEN. lanes/notes.go's publish script keeps its own NOTES_TOKEN, and its tests match it.

Remaining: wait for lr-go on the PR head; on red, read the log, fix, push. When it is green, merge with `ccx vcs merge 3756 -R yasyf/cc-skills --admin --match-head-commit <full head>`, then read main's lr-go for the merge sha. Then post landed --pr, SendMessage team-lead with PR, merge sha and main's result, and post a plain done record.
